hero_sub: Many Models, One Manufacturer, Consistent Quality
hero: Running a spares business in Nigeria means stocking parts for dozens of bike models and keeping the fast movers on the shelf. As a motorcycle spare parts supplier for Nigeria, we help by supplying clutch and engine spares for many models from one IATF 16949 certified factory.
We make the parts ourselves, using CNC machining, die casting and heat treatment, which means the part you reorder next year matches the one you sold this year.
Mixed orders are boxed and labelled by model before they ship to Lagos, so sorting stock on arrival is quick.

faq_intro: Answers for Nigerian spares buyers planning an order.
faqs: Can one shipment hold parts for many bike models?
Yes. We box each model separately and label every carton so sorting is easy on arrival.
Are these your own products or traded parts?
They are made in our own plant in Delhi under IATF 16949 quality systems.
Can you help me decide what to stock?
Yes. Send your model list and our team will suggest parts and quantities.
How do the parts get to Nigeria?
By sea to Lagos in palletised packing, as a full or shared container, with shipping papers for your agent.
Is a small first order possible?
Yes. Start with a balanced trial order and adjust later shipments once you see what sells.
Can boxes carry our own brand?
Yes. Private label cartons are available.
